text:
viv: Heads up 1: our new Next + LlamaChain Turbopack demo is making duplicate embeddings on page load in dev when HMR kicks in. Pretty noisy for new devs.
omar: Hmm. Is that SSR + client hydration or double client mounts from HMR?
jade: Can you share steps? I can repro with turbopack enabled.
viv: Repo: github.com/redwood-inference/next-turbo-llamachain branch: turbopack-demo. Steps: npm i, NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_KEY set, npm run dev (turbopack), open /play, then save a small file to trigger HMR. I see two POST /v1/embeddings right away and the UI shows duplicate streamed chunks.
claire: Logs:

```
2025-09-02T10:01:02Z INFO index: start job=idx-9
2025-09-02T10:01:02Z DEBUG embeddings: req=G1 input=page_text
2025-09-02T10:01:02Z DEBUG embeddings: req=G2 input=page_text
```

viv: G1/G2 same payload but different ids. HMR caused the client component to mount twice before our inflight dedupe could run.
remy: Is this an SDK parity gap? Does python coalesce in-process?
omar: Python had request coalescing for identical embed payloads. JS doesn't by default. We also saw issues where auth refresh can race.
jade: Temporary fix I pushed to the demo: a tiny global inflight map keyed by JSON.stringify(input) attached to window.__redwood_inflight to survive HMR double-mounts. Patch: gist: https://gist.github.com/example/turbopack-dedupe
viv: Patch looks like: 

```ts
// lib/dedupe-embed.ts
const globalAny = window as any;
if(!globalAny.__rwi) globalAny.__rwi = new Map();
export function dedupeEmbed(input){
  const k = JSON.stringify(input);
  if(globalAny.__rwi.has(k)) return globalAny.__rwi.get(k);
  const p = client.embeddings.create({input}).finally(()=> globalAny.__rwi.delete(k));
  globalAny.__rwi.set(k,p);
  return p;
}
```

claire: Ugly but effective for developer experience. We should not ship that to prod.
remy: Agreed. SDK fix should be better: 1) optional request coalescing for embeddings; 2) single-inflight auth refresh per client instance; 3) docs on dev servers (HMR) causing duplicate mounts.
viv: Also added a tiny dev helper script so new devs can run `npm run dev:token` to mint a short-lived demo token instead of creating org keys. Script uses local dev auth and prints a token. Helps onboarding.
jade: Nice DX win. Add it to README with an FAQ entry: "Why do I see duplicate network calls in dev?"
omar: I'll open an SDK issue with a minimal repro (turbopack HMR + hybrid page) + logs and link to the demo PR.
sdk-bot: New issue created: RED-SDK-980 - js-sdk: opt-in embedding coalescing + single-inflight auth refresh (https://tracker.redwood.ai/RED-SDK-980) :mag_right:
jade: Also adding a Playwright test in the demo that asserts at most one POST /v1/embeddings on initial full load in CI (record network requests). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-turbo-llamachain/pull/4
claire: For docs: add a section "Dev server quirks (HMR/Turbopack)" under samples explaining HMR double-mounts and recommended workarounds (dedupe wrapper for dev only, dev token script, prefer client-only streaming in demos).
remy: SDK team: please add an opt-in boolean coalesceEmbeddings and an internal refresh mutex so concurrent 401s don't produce multiple refresh flows. That will let us remove demo hacks.
sdk-bot: SDK team assigned RED-SDK-980; ETA sprint+1.
viv: Thanks all. For now demo PR includes the dev-only dedupe + README note + Playwright assertion. Will revert dedupe once SDK PR merges. Closing loop and filing followup to track revert. :tada:
